description: A JSON OpenAPI specification defining API endpoints related to Wi-Fi MAC Address ACL Profiles, including operations to add, list, get, set, and delete profiles, along with their request/response schemas and error handling.

methods.name: Services.Local.Wi-Fi.ACL.Profiles.Add
methods.description: Adds a new Wi-Fi MAC Address ACL Profile with specified configuration.

methods.name: Services.Local.Wi-Fi.ACL.Profiles.List
methods.description: Retrieves a list of existing Wi-Fi MAC Address ACL Profiles with optional pagination.

methods.name: Services.Local.Wi-Fi.ACL.Profiles.{ProfileId}.Get
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific Wi-Fi MAC Address ACL Profile identified by ProfileId.

methods.name: Services.Local.Wi-Fi.ACL.Profiles.{ProfileId}.Set
methods.description: Modifies configuration parameters of an existing Wi-Fi MAC Address ACL Profile identified by ProfileId.

methods.name: Services.Local.Wi-Fi.ACL.Profiles.{ProfileId}.Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified Wi-Fi MAC Address ACL Profile identified by ProfileId.
